test_title: PYST 62: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given

letter series.

M N _ O J K M _ Q O J K _ N Q _ J K M N Q O _ K M N
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: M N _ O J K M _ Q O J K _ N Q _ J K M N Q O _ K M N

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) QMNJO → M N __Q__ O J K / M __M__ Q O J K / __N__ N Q __J__ J K / M N Q O __O__ K M N

Option 2) QNJMO → M N __Q__ O J K / M __N__ Q O J K / __J__ N Q __M__ J K / M N Q O __O__ K M N

Option 3) QNMJO → M N __Q__ O J K / M __N__ Q O J K / __M__ N Q __J__ J K / M N Q O __O__ K M N

Option 4) **QNMOJ **→ M N __**Q**__ O J K / M __**N**__ Q O J K / __**M**__ N Q **__O__** J K / M N Q O **__J__ **K M N

Here, 'M N Q O J K M N' this pattern is followed.

Hence, the correct answer is "**QNMOJ**".
